plan: docs/STAGE_PLAN.md (wind-journal-baselines, approved at db32df0; line 84 column mapping corrected by Codex); decisions in docs/review/DECISIONS.md

development_only.loader: run_x1.development + run_x2.split_masks (train, V1, V2); every window's label hour must be before the V2 end
development_only.gfs_caches: the development point caches of run_x5.farm_caches (K/P: G1 prepared points_{0,1}.npz; HoT: hot_dev points_{0,1}.npz); cycles at or after the farm's V2 end are dropped before use
development_only.cohorts: V1/V2 issue/turbine/truth hashes and the train count must equal X2 part A before any smoke slicing; a shifted V1 must be detected (negative control)

x2_a.role: business reference for the Cabin line only; does not replace LightGBM-hist

x5.predictions: krr: D{d}/<farm>/{LG,LUG}_d{d}/2024/V2.npy (d = 6, 18); tsg: X5/<farm>/{LG,LUG}_mix@{d}/V2.npy (d = 6, 18); SHA-checked against X5/registry.json of the pinned receipt

cabin.license: MIT, Copyright (c) 2024 Senzhen Wu, Yu Chen, Xinhao He, Zhijin Wang, Xiufeng Liu, Yonggang Fu

models/vendor_cabin/LICENSE.origin: LICENSE, raw file at the commit

models/vendor_tsg/clean_torch_custom_lay.origin: copy with exactly two lines replaced by comments: the unused imports `import cvxpy as cp` and `from cvxpylayers.torch import CvxpyLayer` (tests/test_wjb.py restores them and checks the upstream blob)

statistics.loss: absolute error, window-uniform, clustered by issue time

readouts.gain: MAE(reference) - MAE(candidate) in kW, positive favours the candidate; identical predictions -> 0 without bootstrap
readouts.U: MAE(LG) - MAE(LUG) (KRR, TSG) or MAE(L0) - MAE(LU) (Cabin line), same windows
readouts.rise: U(18) - U(6) on the same windows (run_x5.rise_losses)
readouts.metrics: MAE, RMSE, R2 per horizon 1..4 and overall, V2 only
readouts.18h_note: all four target leads lie beyond f018 at 18 h, so U(18) includes the loss of forecast coverage

krr.features: run_x2.tree_matrix(info) of the delay-d inputs (last-step info columns + 24 h power + 24 h nacelle wind + HoT retrofit) with the turbine id replaced by a one-hot block; standardised with the fit-window mean / std (std <= 1e-12 -> scale 1)
krr.target: truth / rated, 4 outputs; predictions x rated
krr.centre_rule: numpy default_rng(2024).choice(n_train, 300, replace=False), sorted; same rows for every condition and candidate of a farm
krr.solver: alpha = (K_nm' K_nm + n lambda K_mm + jitter I)^-1 K_nm' Y, accumulated in chunks (float64)
krr.candidate_order: c outer, lambda inner; sigma = c x sigma_med, sigma_med = median pairwise distance of the 300 standardised centres (> 0 or error)

saturation.rule: flag only; saturated candidates still enter the V1 selection

lgbh.layout: e dynamic channels over 24 h (time-major), then 24 h power, then the two constants once; built from the same cabin_raw arrays as Cabin
lgbh.lightgbm: configs/x1_protocol.json lightgbm: objective l1, learning rate 0.05, at most 4000 trees, early stopping 200 on V1, feature/bagging fraction 0.8, grid num_leaves {31, 127} x min_child_samples {50, 200}; one model per horizon; no categorical column

cabin.inputs: x = x50 channel 49 over 24 h; e = channels 0-7 (L0) or 0-19 (LU) over 24 h + HoT retrofit flag (0 at K/P) + turbine index / number of turbines; MinMax per channel on the fit windows (constant -> scale 1); target truth / rated
cabin.model: Cabin(input_window_size=24, input_vars=1, output_window_size=4, output_vars=1, ex_vars=C, hidden_size=h, mode='data_first', use_sample_softmax=False)
cabin.early_stopping: V1 MSE of the normalised outputs; best epoch kept; candidate selection by V1 MAE (kW)

independence.rule: earliest 8 V1 windows predicted alone vs between 64 strictly later windows, CPU copy of every trained candidate; negative control: the author's sample softmax switched on must exceed the tolerance

tsg.variant: ARR(learn): Learn_FiniteAdapt_Robust_Reg, learned partitions, linear decision rules, greedy attack, inequality budget
tsg.mapping: tree_matrix columns without the validity bits 34..46; value channel 21 + k sits at value_start + k (k = 0..12); target_col = those 13 positions, fix_col = all others; validity bits only through the mask
tsg.scaling: MinMax on the 50 000 fit windows (value columns: valid cells only; constant -> scale 1), then every cell whose raw validity bit is 0 is set back to 0; mask a = 1 exactly there
tsg.mix: numpy default_rng(2024): run_x5.mix_assignment over the FULL train then the FULL V1 (X5 call order); counts must equal X5 <farm>_mix.json; assignment SHA recorded
tsg.sample_rule: default_rng(2024).choice(n_train, 50000, replace=False), sorted by row then stably by issue time; the same rows for LG and LUG
tsg.max_gap_note: the author script passes max_gap=-1e5, which is not a fit() parameter (it lands in **kwargs, unused); the effective threshold is fit()'s default 0.001, used here explicitly
tsg.per_horizon: one single-output tree per horizon (author trees are single-output): 3 farms x 2 infos x 4 candidates x 4 horizons = 96 trees
tsg.acceptance: 6 h and 18 h V2 validity bits and masks differ; mask only at the 13 positions and = 1 - validity; missing cells 0 after scaling; hand-built tree routed by the author's apply/predict (all-valid -> root, f valid -> left, f missing -> right; nominal model iff the mask equals the node pattern); natural 6 h vs 18 h prediction difference logged only
tsg.time_limit_scope: all three farms together: wall time from the start of mode tsg; the three farms have identical job sets (50 000 windows, 4 candidates x 4 horizons x 2 infos), so 15 h in total = 5 h per farm
tsg.time_limit_rule: 15 h = 3 x the plan's upper estimate (5 h for the whole TSG line). After every finished tree: stop when elapsed + remaining_lower_bound > 15 h, where remaining_lower_bound = max(sum of remaining work / workers, longest remaining job), each unfinished tree counted at the mean wall time of finished trees of its candidate minus the time it has already run, candidates without a finished tree counted 0 (R1-B4). Exceeded -> technical_limit.json, failed.json type TechnicalLimit, the other lines are still reported; smoke has no limit
